p.title: The legacy chat resolver guessed tickers from name fragments
p.symptom: The legacy fuzzy resolver mapped fragments such as '마크', '마이크로' and '테슬' to issuers, so a ticker-shaped or partial name was rewritten to another company.
p.root_cause: The legacy resolver predates P1339 and kept a substring table.
p.fix: _resolveTickerFromFuzzy looks up exact keys only; the fragment keys are removed and the full-name keys are explicit.
p.prevention: T535b asserts exact-only resolution and that fragments do not resolve.
